description: Breaks L3 (at most MAX_COPIES = 1 of a card per deck): 20 cards, of which core-001 appears twice. It necessarily breaks L5 too - a launch-grant profile owns exactly one copy of every non-Token card (R111), so two copies across the loadout is one more than is owned - and the spec asserts both messages rather than pretending L3 can be provoked alone with MAX_COPIES = 1.
